svg.title: Context panel in three situations
svg.desc: Mock: the right-dock Context panel for an OMP chat (everything), a Codex chat (no breakdown, no cost) and a Claude Code terminal without hooks (state only, with the way to get more). Invented data.
svg.text: Context panel (right dock): the same layout, honest about what each harness reports
fork or rewind from any turn
No breakdown: Codex reports one number (last request, not the running total).
fork or rewind from any turn
Codex reports no cost: shown as —, never computed here.
Not reported. This terminal tells Hutan its state only
(program status), not tokens, tools or cost.
pastes /add-dir <path> at the prompt for you to confirm
Turn rows need the transcript or hooks. Past-turn fork is
available for chats, where Hutan owns the journal.
chat journal + /context snapshot: breakdown, per-turn tokens and cost
chat journal only: one context number, no breakdown, no cost
C Claude Code in a terminal, no hooks
state only; the panel says what to install and still offers fork and add folder
